flagged.title: Product Life Cycle & Boston Matrix
flagged.reason: The video tells students they will not be tested on drawing the PLC curve or Boston Matrix (F8), which is unsafe advice and potentially mark-affecting as AQA provides no drawing exemption for these specifications.

mark_affecting.quote: Please keep in mind that you will not be tested on your ability to physically draw the lifecycle curve... focus entirely on how you interpret the business data
